sql: SELECT p.district_label, SUM(CASE WHEN c.arrest = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS arrested, SUM(CASE WHEN c.arrest = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_arrested FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts p ON c.district_id = p.district_id GROUP BY p.district_id, p.district_label ORDER BY p.district_label

SELECT ca.community_area_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.arrest) AS REAL) / COUNT(*), 3) AS arrest_rate FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON ca.community_area_id = c.community_area_id GROUP BY ca.community_area_id, ca.community_area_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY arrest_rate DESC, ca.community_area_name

SELECT p.district_label, c.case_number, c.crime_date FROM police_districts p JOIN crimes c ON c.district_id = p.district_id WHERE c.crime_id = (SELECT c2.crime_id FROM crimes c2 WHERE c2.district_id = p.district_id ORDER BY c2.crime_date DESC, c2.case_number ASC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY p.district_label
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE domestic = 1 AND arrest = 1
SELECT MIN(crime_date) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type = 'HOMICIDE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE district_id = 24

SELECT i.iucr, i.primary_description, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crimes c JOIN iucr_codes i ON i.iucr = c.iucr WHERE c.location_description = 'STREET' AND c.arrest = 1 GROUP BY i.iucr, i.primary_description ORDER BY cnt DESC, i.iucr
SELECT ward, COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE arrest = 1 GROUP BY ward ORDER BY ward

WITH t AS (SELECT p.district_label, ca.community_area_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts p ON c.district_id = p.district_id JOIN community_areas ca ON ca.community_area_id = c.community_area_id GROUP BY p.district_id, p.district_label, ca.community_area_id, ca.community_area_name), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY district_label ORDER BY n DESC, community_area_name) AS rn FROM t) SELECT district_label, community_area_name, n FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY district_label

SELECT ca.community_area_name, SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week1, SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-08' AND '2026-07-14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week2, SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-08' AND '2026-07-14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON ca.community_area_id = c.community_area_id WHERE date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-14' GROUP BY ca.community_area_id, ca.community_area_name ORDER BY diff DESC, ca.community_area_name

SELECT c.iucr, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', c.crime_date) IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS weekend_pct FROM crimes c GROUP BY c.iucr HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY weekend_pct DESC, c.iucr
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE ward = 50 AND domestic = 0
SELECT MAX(updated_on) FROM crimes WHERE iucr = '0110'
SELECT p.district_label, COUNT(*) FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts p ON c.district_id = p.district_id WHERE c.ward = 42 GROUP BY p.district_id, p.district_label ORDER BY p.district_label
